items.title: Manitoba Government Adds Doctors to Health Links to Strengthen Care, Reduce Emergency Room Referrals
Key federal cabinet ministers set to address Assembly of First Nations
items.description: AFN Chief Cindy Woodhouse Nepinak has said Budget 2025 failed First Nations because it did not include more infrastructure funding and educational resources for their communities.

items.title: Carney ‘will have to answer' questions after tax credit flip-flop, Liberal MP says
items.description: A British Columbia Liberal MP said Prime Minister Mark Carney "will have to answer" questions on why he reversed a budget commitment on tax credits in Alberta energy deal.

items.title: EQB to acquire PC Financial from Loblaw for about $800M
items.description: Canada's seventh-largest bank has agreed to acquire PC Financial from Loblaws Co. Ltd. in the latest deal to shake up the country's financial landscape.

items.title: Consultations set to begin on controversial Quebec constitution bill
items.description: Critics say the constitution bill would erode human rights and limit dissent, and could reopen an unnecessary debate on abortion.

items.title: Equipment failure thwarts N.B. power plant from resuming production
items.description: As frigid temperatures approach New Brunswick, the troubled Point Lepreau nuclear generating station missed its expected return to service date earlier this week.

items.title: Canadian families could pay $1,000 more for groceries in 2026, report warns
items.description: Canadians could face grocery bills up to $1,000 higher in 2026 as food prices rise 4-6 per cent, with restaurants and meat seeing the biggest jumps.

items.title: Tow truck operators urge drivers to slow down after fatal hit-and-run on 401
items.description: Southwestern Ontario’s towing industry is feeling a mixture of disappointment and heartbreak following the hit-and-run death of one of their own this week, with some saying the death is proof that the attitudes of drivers need to change for safety to be possible.

items.title: Richmond Christmas Fund marks another year of local support
items.description: The long-running initiative invites the community to donate new toys and enjoy family-friendly activities.

items.title: Calgary city council 2026 budget passes, approves 1.64% property tax increase
items.description: Calgary city council voted in favour of a 1.64 per cent property tax increase, which is anticipated to cost the typical homeowner an additional $4.50 monthly.

items.title: You Nearly Missed: Jane Siberry continuing to write her own rule book at the Rickshaw
items.description: Get ready for a true Canadian original.

items.title: Munk debate featuring former Israeli officials met with protests, allegations of war crimes
items.description: As many as 200 people protested outside the Munk Debates in Toronto on Wednesday, where a panel of all-Israeli speakers discussed whether a two-state solution is in the best interest of Israel.
